description: I`m now up to the challenge of rice-planting! It should be a piece of cake once I exercise my power... Uh oh, so difficult. Huh? The legendary rice-planting music? It will be possible to do the job with it? So what is it? Tell me, tell me.

titles.title: Den`en ni Mau Megami no Densetsu
田園に舞う女神の伝説
